in_marathi.name: Gunjitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sound of Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gunjitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gunji, meaning 'sound,' represents the triumphant and victorious vibrations of the universe. Tha, signifies Goddess Tripura Sundari, the embodiment of female power and creativity. Thus, Gunjitha is the one who brings the sound of victory in the presence of the divine.

in_bengali.name: Gunjitha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Sound of Victory
in_bengali.long_meaning: Gunjitha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Gunji, meaning 'sound,' represents the triumphant and victorious vibrations of the universe. Tha, signifies Goddess Tripura Sundari, the embodiment of female power and creativity. Thus, Gunjitha is the one who brings the sound of victory in the presence of the divine.
